announcements.headline: Publication of Annual Report and Accounts
announcements.insight: Impax Asset Management Group publishes its annual report following the September 2026 results notice. Shareholders should review the detailed financial performance and governance disclosures contained within.

announcements.headline: Results for the year ended 30 September 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual results for the financial year ended 30 September 2026. Shareholders will review the disclosed performance metrics to assess the company's operational and financial health over the period.

announcements.headline: Investor Presentation of Final Results
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of final results accompanied by an investor presentation, which typically provides shareholders with a detailed review of the company's financial performance and strategic outlook for the period.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that scheduled financial results will be published, providing shareholders with an update on the company's performance and financial position. The headline does not specify the direction or magnitude of the results, so it represents a standard periodic disclosure rather than a material event.
